insight:
At the third Stellar Talks event, we were joined by Sırrı Oğuz, Pyrotechnic Systems Manager at NASA Johnson Space Center. The insights he shared with us regarding NASA projects, the systems used in these projects, space missions, and his experiences were invaluable.

Don't forget to learn how to use LS-DYNA and stay connected with space! 💫

insight:
The first guest of our Stellar Talks event was Denizhan Akbal, one of our biggest supporters.

A Koç University graduate who founded and manages DPFlow, Denizhan shared with us his career journey from his university years to the industry, his experiences in aerospace, the challenges he encountered, and the story behind his startup. He also shared valuable advice for those aspiring to pursue a career in this field! 🚀
